_comment: Expected content of the owner-imported stock audio assets. HASHES ONLY - no vendor
content is shipped here or anywhere else in this package, and the device runs the pmOS
chain when these files are absent.
This replaces the size checks that biscuit-mic-stream.sh and the settings layer used to
make. A size check passes a truncated-to-the-right-length file and, worse, passes a file
from the WRONG GENERATION that happens to match - which is the failure this exists to
catch, because the two chains are disjoint and a wrong-generation file would be loaded as
coefficients and produce silence or noise rather than an error.
Cost, measured on this hardware: 5 ms to hash all four Fire OS 6 files in process, 31 ms
through one busybox sha256sum fork. A branch restart already costs about ten seconds, so
the earlier reasoning that hashing would be wasted work was wrong by three orders of
required=false means the chain runs without the file - vad_lite.tflite is the stock DNN
voice detector, and the energy prototype is a working alternative, qualified separately.
An optional file that is PRESENT is still verified: a corrupt model would be loaded and
would gate adaptation on nonsense rather than refusing.

The firmware profile is MediaTek's MT6625L WLAN firmware, which the driver requests by the bare name WIFI_RAM_CODE. It is owner-imported for the same reason the audio assets are: it is not ours to redistribute. Unlike the Bluetooth ROM patches and the FPGA bitstream it CAN be imported, because wlan_mt6625l is a loadable module that comes up around t=35 s - the others are requested by built-in drivers at t=0.6-1.2 s, seconds before any filesystem exists, which is why the installer and biscuit-boot-update append this Echo's own copies to its boot image's initramfs instead.

The speaker profile is Fire OS's speaker correction curve, system/vendor/etc/audio-algorithms/EQ_50.cfg: 1024 FIR coefficients, one per line with a trailing comma. It is byte-identical on Fire OS 5 and 6, and EQ_60.cfg and EQ_70.cfg are the same bytes, so any of them imports. A profile of its own rather than part of fireos6 because every generation can supply it and it has nothing to do with the microphones. activation=none: biscuit-dsp reads it straight from the store (directory below is the store itself), so there is nothing to link and nothing for a flash to lose. Without it the Stock equaliser plays flat.
